calvino_source.inner_arch: Each city receives its form from the desert it opposes; and so the camel driver and the sailor see Despina, a border city between two deserts.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Bi-stable optical/silhouette horizon instrument without a neutral middle truth + Hand-Colored Copperplate Border Map & Fine-Art City Plate
anti_trude_vector.physics: Double-well cusp potential U(p) = -0.5*(p-0.5)^2 + 0.25*(p-0.5)^4 across shared normalized skyline spine nodes N0..N8 and threshold chambers C0..C2. p=0.5 is dynamically unstable: crossing the border triggers mirage scan-refraction directly between the maritime port vessel and the swaying camel caravan with zero neutral third architectural form.
anti_trude_vector.dom_signature_strategy: Bespoke <despina-*> custom HTML5 element hierarchy and .dsp-* CSS selector namespace with zero generic container boilerplate, guaranteeing J_dom < 0.35.

epistemic_partition.board_hygiene: Layer builders never call read_board and post ONLY '@despina-border-weaver ready: layers/<filename>.js' with zero rationale prose so neither contaminates the shared board before weaving.

roles.name: despina-camel-driver
roles.role: Epistemically partitioned builder of the ochre tableland horizon morphing industrial pinnacles into windjammer/steamboat and harbor chambers.

roles.name: despina-sailor
roles.role: Epistemically partitioned builder of the slate coastline salt-haze morphing swaying spotted humps and fringed saddle into caravan packs, palm oasis, and veiled court dancers.

roles.role: Binds both opposing desert projections across the shared skyline spine into standalone index.html with zero neutral middle view plus an inspectable Map & City Plate drawer (map.png & image.png).

roles.name: despina-critic
roles.role: Blind-recognition, epistemic-opposition, and plate/cartography verifier checking zero neutral third view, full stone participation, map.svg/map.png/image.png quality, responsive viewports (1280x800 & 390x844), keyboard/reduced-motion support, and Anti-Trude DOM uniqueness.
